newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH IVO SAYS SIGNS DEM 760 MLN SYNDICATED LOAN.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH IVO SAYS SIGNS DEM 760 MLN SYNDICATED LOAN.

text.p: Finnish state-owned power group Imatran Voima Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had signed a DEM 760 million seven-year syndicated loan with a group of banks led by Finnish Merita and U.S. Chase Manhattan .
"The loan period is seven years during which the loan can be flexibly drawn down or repaid as needed," IVO said, adding the intererst margin on the loan was Libor plus 0.15 percentage points.

The loan arangement would be needed if a payment to IVO from the state for its stake in the nation-wide electricity grid was delayed due to the postponement of work in parliament on a related tax bill, IVO said.

It might also need to draw on the funds if its offers to buy some electric utilities met favourable responses, IVO said, adding it could also use the facility to repay some short-term loans once it had received payment from the grid sale.
